profiles.notes: Published shared course and application rules for clinical progression in 2028.

requirements.label: 2028 clinical entry · eligible Auckland degrees
requirements.details: Complete year one in Biomedical Science, Community Health or Health Systems and Data Analytics within Health Sciences, or one of six Science majors: Cell and Molecular Bioscience, Exercise Sciences, Medicinal Chemistry, Nutrition, Pharmacology or Physiology. Use a full-time year and first attempts in the eight required courses.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2028 clinical entry · eligible Auckland degrees

requirements.label: 2028 clinical entry · eight Auckland courses
requirements.details: Take BIOSCI 107, CHEM 190, MEDSCI 142 and POPLHLTH 111. Add WTRMHS 100 in Biomedical Science and Health Sciences or WTRSCI 100 in Science, plus three courses worth 15 points each from the qualifying degree.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2028 clinical entry · eight Auckland courses

requirements.label: 2028 clinical entry · progression application deadline
requirements.details: Apply for clinical year-two entry by 1 July 2027 during the qualifying first year. The stated admission cycle is 2028.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2028 clinical entry · progression application deadline

profiles.notes: Clinical admission after the first year of university study. The GPA is a university selection measure.

requirements.label: 2027 clinical entry · first-year course requirements
requirements.details: Complete eight full-time Auckland courses in BHSc or the then-current BSc Biomedical Science route. Both take BIOSCI 107, CHEM 110, MEDSCI 142 and POPLHLTH 111. Add POPLHLTH 101, POPLHLTH 102, HLTHPSYC 122 and WTRMHS 100 in BHSc. BSc Biomedical Science takes BIOSCI 101, BIOSCI 106 and PHYSICS 160 and WTRSCI 100. First attempts are assessed.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2027 clinical entry · first-year course requirements

requirements.label: 2027 clinical entry · interview eligibility
requirements.details: The published university GPA minimum for interview consideration is 6.0 across the seven assessed courses without failing any. The listed Auckland compulsory WTR course must be passed. Interview invitations are ranked.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2027 clinical entry · interview eligibility

requirements.label: 2027 clinical entry · final ranking
requirements.details: Final ranking weights the GPA in BIOSCI 107, CHEM 110, MEDSCI 142 and POPLHLTH 111 at 60%, UCAT ANZ at 15% and the Multiple Mini Interview at 25%. Sit UCAT ANZ in the year of application.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2027 clinical entry · final ranking

profiles.notes: Clinical selection after the restructured 2027 first-year pathway. The listed GPA is a university result.

requirements.label: 2028 clinical entry · university GPA threshold
requirements.details: The degree page states GPA 6.0 in the four required courses and requires applicants to earn at least B in every first-year course. The interview ranking considers the core GPA and may use interim grades until official results are available.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2028 clinical entry · university GPA threshold

requirements.label: 2028 clinical entry · final ranking
requirements.details: Auckland’s Casper and the Multiple Mini Interview each account for 50% of final selection. Sit Casper in the application year.

source.title: University of Auckland · 2028 clinical entry · final ranking

profiles.notes: International graduate entry for Medicine.

requirements.label: International Medicine graduate · degree and GPA
requirements.details: Complete a relevant degree at a recognised university full time, with at least GPA/GPE 6.0 and courses equivalent to BIOSCI 107, CHEM 110, MEDSCI 142 and POPLHLTH 111. The last full-time year must be within five years of applying. Pending graduates must provide final results by 30 November in the application year.

requirements.details: The published international graduate route exempts UCAT ANZ. Shortlisted applicants interview via Kira Talent. GPA/GPE and interview score each contribute 50% to final ranking.

profiles.notes: Law Part II progression for 2027; places are subject to faculty selection.

requirements.label: Law Part II · required university grades
requirements.details: Pass LAW 121G. Earn at least C+ in each of LAW 131 and LAW 141. Pass 120 points over eight courses with overall LawGPA of at least 3.00. At least 75 points must be in non-Law courses, including 60 eligible for the LawGPA.

source.title: University of Auckland · Law Part II · required university grades

requirements.label: Law Part II · selection and guaranteed threshold
requirements.details: The LawGPA takes LAW 121G, LAW 131 and LAW 141 plus the best 60 eligible non-Law points in the most recent academic year. Waipapa Taumata Rau and General Education courses other than LAW 121G are excluded. Eligible applicants with LawGPA 6.50 or higher have guaranteed entry, and lower eligible GPAs are subject to available places.

source.title: University of Auckland · Law Part II · selection and guaranteed threshold
